items.title: Fake-download campaign uses trojanized installers to deliver monetization payloads
items.summary: Microsoft Threat Intelligence tracks a fake-download campaign that uses trojanized Inno installers to deliver multiple monetization offers and provides detection and investigation guidance across the complete installer session.The post Fake-download campaign uses trojanized installers to deliver monetization payloads appeared first on Microsoft Security Blog.
items.creator: Microsoft Security Research and Jiacen Xu
